title: Itô calculus, lognormal prices, and the meaning of a risk probability
objectives: Solve the Brownian density equation and state the conditions behind a central limit argument
Derive quadratic variation and the correction to the ordinary chain rule
Solve geometric Brownian motion and derive its density, moments, and return conventions
Separate an endpoint loss probability from the probability of crossing a liquidity boundary
prerequisites: Chapter16's Brownian increments, covariance, and diffusion equation; Taylor expansion, integration by parts, and Gaussian probability.
source_scope: All official English captions at playlist positions40–43 read sequentially. Equations reconstructed; no comprehensive audiovisual audit. Quadratic-variation and endpoint-versus-hitting corrections are explicit.
